text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":4,"unit":"friends","kind":"count","span":"4 friends who came to visit"},{"id":"q2","value":20,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"pressed on the doorbell 20 times"},{"id":"q3","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/4 times more (numerator)"},{"id":"q4","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/4 times more (denominator)"},{"id":"q5","value":10,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"10 times more than the fourth friend"},{"id":"q6","value":60,"unit":"times","kind":"count","span":"the fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"first friend's presses times the fraction numerator, part of computing how much more the second friend pressed"},{"op":"div","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"divide by the fraction denominator to get the extra amount the second friend pressed beyond the first friend"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"first friend's presses plus the extra amount gives the second friend's total presses"},{"op":"add","args":["q6","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"fourth friend's presses plus 10 more gives the third friend's total presses"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"first friend's presses plus second friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["s5","s4"],"out":"s6","note":"plus the third friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["s6","q6"],"out":"s7","note":"plus the fourth friend's presses gives the total doorbell rings"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of times the doorbell rang from all four friends"},"dismissed":[{"value":4,"reason":"the count of Jerome's friends (4) is just context; each friend's doorbell presses are given individually and summed instead"}]}
